content:
Just wrapped up an incredible M&A workshop which is the Vidhi Parv, organised by the Academic Committee - MNLU Nagpur of MNLU Nagpur and as a second-year law student it was truly an eye-opening deep dive into the world of Mergers & Acquisitions. 

Over the sessions, we traced the entire lifecycle of a deal from term sheets and due diligence to definitive agreements like the SPA and SHA and the regulatory mechanism of the Companies Act, SEBI's Takeover Code that shapes how listed and unlisted companies operate so differently. 

A huge thank you to the Academic Committee - MNLU Nagpur committee for organising this incredible learning opportunity and to the partners and speakers for generously giving their time and sharing their real-world insight with us. 
Grateful for this experience and excited to keep exploring this space!
comment: Beyond documentation and agreements, the real test in M&A often lies in aligning commercial intent with regulatory constraints and execution realities after closing—the integration phase is where many deals create or lose value.
